title: VCS Repository Loading Flow
interaction_flow: VcsRepository::initialize() → self::getDriver(): selects and instantiates driver class (github/gitlab/git/etc.) by type match or URL supports() check
VcsRepository::getDriver() → Driver::new($repoConfig, $io, $config, $httpDownloader, $processExecutor)
VcsRepository::getDriver() → driver->initialize(): driver sets up auth, parses URL, creates Cache, calls fetchRootIdentifier() (GitHub: API call)
GitHubDriver::initialize() → fetchRootIdentifier(): HTTP GET GitHub API /repos/{owner}/{repo} to get default branch and repoData
VcsRepository::initialize() → driver->hasComposerFile(driver->getRootIdentifier()): checks if root ref has composer.json
VcsDriver::hasComposerFile(id) → self::getComposerInformation(id): returns non-null means file exists
VcsDriver::getComposerInformation(id): checks infoCache[id], then cache->read(id) if SHA40, then getBaseComposerInformation(id)
VcsDriver::getBaseComposerInformation(id) → self::getFileContent('composer.json', id): driver-specific fetch (API or git)
GitHubDriver::getFileContent(file, id) → httpDownloader->get(apiUrl/contents/file?ref=id): returns raw file content
VcsDriver::getBaseComposerInformation(id) → JsonFile::parseJson(content): parses to array, adds change date if missing
VcsRepository::initialize() → driver->getTags(): returns map<tagName, identifier> (GitHubDriver: paginates GitHub API /repos/{owner}/{repo}/tags)
VcsRepository::initialize() [for each tag] → self::getCachedPackageVersion(tag, identifier): checks VersionCache->getVersionPackage(version, id)
VcsRepository::initialize() [cache miss] → self::validateTag(tag): VersionParser->normalize(tag) → string|false
VcsRepository::initialize() [valid tag] → driver->getComposerInformation(identifier): fetch composer.json for tag SHA
VcsRepository::initialize() → self::preProcess(driver, data, identifier): sets name, calls driver->getDist(id) + driver->getSource(id) if not set
VcsRepository::initialize() → loader->load(processedData): ArrayLoader creates CompletePackage; if ValidatingArrayLoader checks warnings → InvalidPackageException
VcsRepository::initialize() → self::addPackage(package): stores package in ArrayRepository
VcsRepository::initialize() → driver->getBranches(): returns map<branchName, identifier>; root identifier branch prepended
VcsRepository::initialize() [for each branch] → self::validateBranch(branch): VersionParser->normalizeBranch(branch), parseConstraints(normalized)
VcsRepository::initialize() [branch loop] → getCachedPackageVersion / driver->getComposerInformation / preProcess / loader->load / addPackage (same as tags)
VcsRepository::initialize() → driver->cleanup(): frees any resources (no-op in VcsDriver base)
key_relationships: VcsDriver composes Cache (optional, SHA-keyed disk cache)
GitHubDriver may fall back to GitDriver (when use-github-api=false or no-api)
driver_selection_logic: getDriver(): 1) exact type key match (e.g. 'github' → GitHubDriver); 2) iterate all drivers calling static supports($io,$config,$url); 3) retry with silent=true. First match wins.
cache_strategy: Two-level: (1) VersionCache (cross-run persistent cache, keyed by version+identifier) checked before any HTTP; (2) VcsDriver::infoCache (in-memory per-request, keyed by identifier); (3) Cache->read/write (disk cache, only for 40-char SHA identifiers).
error_handling: TransportException 401/403/429/5xx → rethrow (hard fail). 404 → emptyReferences[]. Tag name invalid → skip. Branch name invalid → skip (branchErrorOccurred=true for generic errors). No packages at all → InvalidRepositoryException.
important_notes: Root identifier branch is always loaded first. Tags strip 'release-' prefix. Branches always get 'dev-' prefix in version. ValidatingArrayLoader warnings cause InvalidPackageException for branches. GitHubDriver::initialize() calls fetchRootIdentifier() which does GitHub API call to get default branch SHA.
